THE IDEA

The Automatic Pet Feeder helps pet owners provide food at scheduled times, even when they are away. It is a practical embedded-system prototype with simple and reliable hardware.

SMART • SIMPLE • EXPANDABLE

05REAL CIRCUIT

The actual circuit used in the project.

CURRENT HARDWARE LAYOUT

Final Electronics Layout

This is the current circuit used for the Smart Pet Feeder. It includes one Arduino Uno, one DS1307 RTC module, one 16×2 I2C LCD, one SG90 servo motor, one push button, one buzzer, a breadboard and jumper wires. No separate external power supply is used in this prototype.

Servo: Pin 9 Buzzer: Pin 8 Button: Pin 2 LCD: I2C 0x27

06SOFTWARE

Smart Pet Feeder v2.0 software.

Latest code synchronized with the real circuit: DS1307 RTC, I2C LCD, one buzzer, manual button control and scheduled feeding at 08:00 / 14:42.

Required Arduino libraries: RTClib, Servo and LiquidCrystal_I2C. Wire is included with Arduino.
smart_pet_feeder_v2.inoArduino sketch
#include <Wire.h>
#include <RTClib.h>
#include <Servo.h>
#include <LiquidCrystal_I2C.h>

// SMART PET FEEDER v2.0

RTC_DS1307 rtc;
Servo feederServo;
LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2);

// PIN SETTINGS
const int SERVO_PIN = 9;
const int BUZZER_PIN = 8;
const int BUTTON_PIN = 2;

// SERVO SETTINGS
const int CLOSED_POSITION = 0;
const int OPEN_POSITION = 90;
const unsigned long FEEDING_TIME = 2000;

// AUTOMATIC FEEDING TIMES
const int MORNING_HOUR = 8;
const int MORNING_MINUTE = 0;

const int EVENING_HOUR = 14;
const int EVENING_MINUTE = 42;

// Prevent repeated automatic feeding on the same day
uint32_t lastMorningFeed = 0;
uint32_t lastEveningFeed = 0;

// Button debounce
int lastButtonReading = HIGH;
int stableButtonState = HIGH;
unsigned long lastButtonChange = 0;

// Screen refresh
unsigned long lastScreenUpdate = 0;


// ====================================
// FEED PET
// ====================================

void feedPet(const char* feedingType) {

  Serial.println("----------------");
  Serial.print("FEEDING: ");
  Serial.println(feedingType);

  lcd.clear();

  lcd.setCursor(0, 0);
  lcd.print(feedingType);

  lcd.setCursor(0, 1);
  lcd.print("PLEASE WAIT");

  // Audible notification
  tone(BUZZER_PIN, 1000);
  delay(300);
  noTone(BUZZER_PIN);

  // Open food gate
  feederServo.write(OPEN_POSITION);

  lcd.setCursor(0, 1);
  lcd.print("GATE OPEN       ");

  Serial.println("Gate opened");

  // Allow food to fall
  delay(FEEDING_TIME);

  // Close food gate
  feederServo.write(CLOSED_POSITION);

  Serial.println("Gate closed");
  Serial.println("FEEDING COMPLETE");

  lcd.clear();

  lcd.setCursor(0, 0);
  lcd.print("FEED COMPLETE");

  lcd.setCursor(0, 1);
  lcd.print("GATE CLOSED");

  delay(1000);

  lastScreenUpdate = 0;
}


// ====================================
// DISPLAY CLOCK AND NEXT FEED
// ====================================

void updateLCD(DateTime now) {

  int nextHour;
  int nextMinute;

  // Calculate next scheduled feeding
  if (now.hour() < MORNING_HOUR) {
    nextHour = MORNING_HOUR;
    nextMinute = MORNING_MINUTE;
  }
  else if (now.hour() < EVENING_HOUR) {
    nextHour = EVENING_HOUR;
    nextMinute = EVENING_MINUTE;
  }
  else {
    nextHour = MORNING_HOUR;
    nextMinute = MORNING_MINUTE;
  }

  char line[17];

  // First LCD row: current time
  snprintf(
    line,
    sizeof(line),
    "TIME %02d:%02d:%02d   ",
    now.hour(),
    now.minute(),
    now.second()
  );

  lcd.setCursor(0, 0);
  lcd.print(line);

  // Second LCD row: next feeding time
  snprintf(
    line,
    sizeof(line),
    "NEXT %02d:%02d      ",
    nextHour,
    nextMinute
  );

  lcd.setCursor(0, 1);
  lcd.print(line);
}


// ====================================
// SETUP
// ====================================

void setup() {

  Serial.begin(9600);

  pinMode(BUTTON_PIN, INPUT_PULLUP);
  pinMode(BUZZER_PIN, OUTPUT);

  // Initialize servo
  feederServo.attach(SERVO_PIN);
  feederServo.write(CLOSED_POSITION);

  // Initialize LCD
  lcd.init();
  lcd.backlight();

  lcd.setCursor(0, 0);
  lcd.print("SMART PET FEEDER");

  lcd.setCursor(0, 1);
  lcd.print("STARTING...");

  // Initialize real-time clock
  if (!rtc.begin()) {

    Serial.println("RTC NOT FOUND!");

    lcd.clear();
    lcd.print("RTC ERROR!");

    while (true) {
      delay(100);
    }
  }

  // Only set RTC time if the clock has stopped
  if (!rtc.isrunning()) {

    rtc.adjust(
      DateTime(F(__DATE__), F(__TIME__))
    );
  }

  Serial.println("SMART PET FEEDER READY");

  delay(1500);

  lcd.clear();
}


// ====================================
// MAIN LOOP
// ====================================

void loop() {

  DateTime now = rtc.now();

  // Unique date: YYYYMMDD
  uint32_t today =
    (uint32_t)now.year() * 10000UL +
    (uint32_t)now.month() * 100UL +
    now.day();

  // Update screen every second
  if (lastScreenUpdate == 0 ||
      millis() - lastScreenUpdate >= 1000) {

    lastScreenUpdate = millis();

    updateLCD(now);

    Serial.print("Current time: ");
    Serial.print(now.hour());
    Serial.print(":");
    Serial.print(now.minute());
    Serial.print(":");
    Serial.println(now.second());
  }

  // =================================
  // MORNING AUTOMATIC FEEDING
  // =================================

  if (
    now.hour() == MORNING_HOUR &&
    now.minute() == MORNING_MINUTE &&
    lastMorningFeed != today
  ) {

    lastMorningFeed = today;
    feedPet("MORNING FEED");
  }

  // =================================
  // EVENING AUTOMATIC FEEDING
  // =================================

  if (
    now.hour() == EVENING_HOUR &&
    now.minute() == EVENING_MINUTE &&
    lastEveningFeed != today
  ) {

    lastEveningFeed = today;
    feedPet("EVENING FEED");
  }

  // =================================
  // MANUAL FEEDING BUTTON
  // =================================

  int reading = digitalRead(BUTTON_PIN);

  // Detect button state change
  if (reading != lastButtonReading) {
    lastButtonChange = millis();
  }

  // Debounce the button
  if (millis() - lastButtonChange > 40) {

    if (reading != stableButtonState) {

      stableButtonState = reading;

      // Trigger only when the button is pressed
      if (stableButtonState == LOW) {

        Serial.println("MANUAL BUTTON PRESSED");

        feedPet("MANUAL FEED");
      }
    }
  }

  lastButtonReading = reading;

  delay(10);
}
